tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.intent: Navigate to a URL in the active browser tab.

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.intent: Navigate back to the previous page in session history.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.intent: Capture structured accessibility snapshot of the current page with element ref IDs for text-first interaction.

tools.name: browser_find
tools.intent: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for matching elements by text or role.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.intent: Click an interactive element by its accessibility snapshot ref ID or coordinates.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.intent: Type text into an editable input or textarea by its element ref ID.

tools.name: browser_fill_form
tools.intent: Fill multiple form fields in a single call using element ref IDs.

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.intent: Select one or more options in a dropdown select element by value or ref ID.

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.intent: Hover over an element by its ref ID to trigger hover states or tooltips.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.intent: Press a keyboard key (e.g. Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown) on the focused element.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.intent: Drag and drop between two elements by source and target ref IDs.

tools.name: browser_drop
tools.intent: Drop files or MIME-typed data onto a target element by ref ID.

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.intent: Upload one or multiple files into a file input element.

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.intent: Accept, dismiss, or respond to browser JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt).

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.intent: List, create, select, or close browser tabs in the current session.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.intent: Wait for specific text to appear/disappear, element state changes, or time to elapse.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.intent: Evaluate a JavaScript expression on the page or inside a specific element context.

tools.name: browser_run_code_unsafe
tools.intent: Execute arbitrary multi-step Playwright scripts directly inside the browser process.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.intent: Capture a visual PNG screenshot of the whole page or a specific element.

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.intent: List all HTTP network requests and responses made by the page since load.

tools.name: browser_network_request
tools.intent: Inspect full headers, query parameters, request body, and response payload of a single network request.

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.intent: Read browser console logs, warnings, errors, and uncaught exceptions.

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.intent: Resize the browser viewport dimensions (width, height) to test responsive layouts.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.intent: Close the active browser page or session.
